lyrics.text: Oh, the rays of our mutual bond
we drive through the quiet land to carry us Across the sky, can't see when they're away, far away
Look at why I don't believe the way
my heart and shame No as we're caught in vain to say my name
Just let the safe options come
Oh, no real issues as fate's outcome
Oh, what we'll do when we're done To set the soul's billet above my soul And we're gone, in your mind, we won't leave
I'm behind, I'm a waste, I'll be quiet Let's play me now
I stand in promise with my heart and chain No as we go in vain to say my name
I storm the silence with her hands away
I save the life from every past regret
So I won't turn away, I won't let go I count the heavens through the fading wires
I strike the fire until the stars align Until the silence from the ancient time
Together we will stop the cosmos We will shop the cosmos, Tuck into the cosmos, hey!
